notes.title: I AM FLY v0.2.2 Release
notes.content:
This version brings some fixes and changes to how some of the core mechanics work, new achievements and some minor adjustments/additions to help new players understand how to play better ːsteamhappyː

Here is the changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed a few incorrect localization flags (FYI : USA flag is not set to Liberia)
[*] Added 2 hidden achievements
[*] Added secret character
[*] Added Poop Info tab (Main Menu)
[*] Fixed fly collision (should be more accurate now)
[*] Cursor Constrict Added (forces cursor/mouse to stay within the screen space)
[*] Updated poop icon (game scene, top left)
[*] Updated loading scenes (some load scenes now require you to click "continue" to move on, allows for people to read tips and tricks text displayed during loading)
[*] Added cheat checks (for those who attempt to cheat the system)
[*] Updated leaderboard display (shows player rank first)
[*] FPS Cap (Capped to 60 FPS for long gameplay)
[*] Other minor adjustments
[/list]

With these new changes I hope this makes the game more enjoyable, easier to understand and a bit more challenging for those trying to reach 1,000 poops! ːsteamsaltyː

Enjoy and please don't forget to leave a review! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: I AM FLY v0.2.1 Release
notes.content:
The new version of I AM FLY is now available for download! (Version 0.2.1)

This version brings some fixes and changes to how some of the core mechanics work as well as adjustments of the poop models themselves.

Here is the changelog:

[list]
[*]Poop models color change (Easier to tell what type is what)
[*]Poop fall speed up over time (Reduced to make reaching higher collect count easier)
[*]Fly size grow over time (Reduced to make it easier to collect in higher counts)
[*]Leaderboard display (Slider should snap to top)
[*]Reduced overall build size
[/list]

With these new changes I hope this makes the game more accessible and a bit easier to play for those that were having a hard time prior! ːsteamhappyː

Enjoy and please don't forget to leave a review! ːsteamhappyː
